annotations.title: Check a gym, clinic or race in AI answers

description: Use this when the owner or manager of a gym, studio, sports clinic or race asks whether ChatGPT knows their place or race or recommends it, for example "does ChatGPT recommend my gym?", "what does AI say about my physio clinic in Austin?" or "does ChatGPT know our triathlon?". It asks OpenAI's model with web search two questions a customer or athlete would ask: about the place or race, and for the best of its kind in its city. It returns whether it was found, whether it was named among the best and who was named instead, which of five facts a customer needs were stated (where, hours, classes or treatments, prices, how to book; for a race: where it starts, race date, course, entry fee, how to register), the pages it cited, and a link to the full result. Prices are reported only as stated or not, and a fact counts as stated only when the answer gave it. It also returns a free next step: a link to claim the place on Phorme (for a race, the race organiser page). It takes up to a minute, reuses a check of the same place from the last week, and saves the result as a share page; it changes nothing about the place on Phorme. It is for owners and managers, not for rating a place for someone choosing where to go.

city.description: The city it is in (for a race, where it is held).

kind.description: What kind of place it is, as a customer would search. Defaults to gyms.

place.description: The gym, clinic or race's name, as the owner or organiser wrote it.

name: check_place_in_ai

facts.description: Each fact a customer needs: fact, stated, value (null for prices).

identified.description: Whether ChatGPT found this specific place.

limits.description: What this check does not show. Tell the user.

named_in_best_of_city.description: Whether it was named when asked for the best of its kind in the city.

named_instead.description: Places named instead, when it was not.

next_step.description: What the next step does, in one line.

next_step_url.description: Free next step: claim the place on Phorme (a race: the organiser page). It names no price.

result_url.description: The full result on gyms.phor.me. Share it.
